verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day crewed test flight orbiting the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The approximately 10-day Artemis II mission around the Moon is the first crewed flight (R1); roughly 10-day flight... loop around the moon (R3); 10-day journey around the moon (R4); 10-day mission around the Moon (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly describe it as a ~10-day crewed test flight/mission around the Moon; 'orbiting' aligns with common description of the trajectory.

verifications.claim: Artemis II verifies NASA's deep-space systems.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: test the systems and hardware needed... in deep space (R1); test flight for Orion's life support systems in deep space (R4); demonstrate key systems... in deep space (R5); test Orion spacecraft’s ability... in space (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state the mission tests/verifies systems in deep space.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew validates the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: test life-support systems and critical operations in deep space (R1); test flight for Orion's life support systems (R4); life-support and environmental systems (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state testing/validation of Orion life-support systems.

verifications.evidence: manually maneuver Orion relative to another spacecraft (R1); manual piloting and proximity operations (R5); crew will command... maneuvers... using... hand controllers (R6)

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew captures high-resolution imagery of the lunar surface.
verifications.label: VAGUE

verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm crew photographs lunar surface during flyby, but do not specify 'high-resolution'.

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first human return to lunar space in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: first crewed deep-space flight in over 50 years (R1); first time... in more than 50 years (R2); first... in more than half a century (R3); first crewed mission to lunar space since... 1972 (R4); first humans back to the Moon in over 50 years (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All sources directly confirm it as first crewed return to lunar vicinity in >50 years.
